title: Credits & community
summary: The people and projects behind the pack.
text:
# Credits & community

**Towns & Kingdoms 3 | Beyond the Forge** is developed by Mikaaah with its community.

The pack builds on the work of the Create, NeoForge, KubeJS, FTB, AE2, Immersive Engineering, Ars Nouveau, Iron's Spells, Epic Fight and many other mod teams. Every entry in the [mod inventory](../mods/) links to its project and names its author.

Custom development includes Towns & Kingdoms Workshop, Towns & Kingdoms Progression, Unidentified Loot, Resonant Arcana, Alchemical Lasers, Flow Control and the Wildshape terrain direction.

Branding and supplied pixel artwork retain their creators' rights. In-game feature assets are not offered here as standalone art packs.

The original TK2 wiki is preserved in the [archive](../2.0/), including historical version numbers and unfinished pages. Its content describes the older pack.

[Discord](https://discord.gg/CRYk3uDPVt) · [GitHub](https://github.com/Mikaaah/TownsAndKingdoms) · [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/towns-kingdoms)

title: Beta 1.0 changelog
summary: Mods added, removed and replaced from TK2 to Beta 1.0, grouped by gameplay category.
text:
# TK2 → TK3: what changed?

**Beta 1.0 · Beyond the Forge · 8 November 2026**

Towns & Kingdoms 3 moves from Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge to **Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge**, with Java 21. Create remains at the heart of the pack, alongside a new industrial route, character progression, more integrated adventures and a broader selection of farming and building mods.

This compares **TK2 3.05** with **TK3 Beta 1.0**. The Beta 1.0 pack files define the complete current mod selection. Each category separates additions, removals and replacements. Mods listed as **continuing** were already part of TK2.

[Download this changelog](../downloads/TNK3-Beta-1.0-Changelog.md) · [Browse the complete project comparison](../mods/comparison/)

## RPG, character progression and loot

**Added**

- **TnK Progression** — character levels, activity progression, twenty origins with two perks each, titles and mob scaling.
- **Pufferfish's Skills** and **Pufferfish's Attributes** — the framework behind the rebuilt skill tree and its bonuses. The current tree has **588 nodes**, with a **175-point budget** for choosing a build.
- **Unidentified Loot** — equipment identification, rarity, discoveries and salvaging, including a Create-powered Mechanical Identifier.
- **Iron's Gems 'n Jewelry** and **Reliquified Artifacts** — more equipment and accessory interactions.

**Replaced**

| TK2 | TK3 |
|---|---|
| Passive Skill Tree + Passive Skill Tree Additions | TnK Progression + Pufferfish's Skills |
| Loot Journal | Loot Journal's NeoForge port |

**Removed:** Apothic Curios.

**Continuing:** Apotheosis, Artifacts and Relics. The RPG overhaul builds on these existing equipment systems.

## Combat and equipment

**Added**

- **Celestisynth** — another weapon family for the equipment selection.
- **Epic Fight Compat Suite**, **Epic Fight Curios Compat** and **Epic Fight X Relics + Artifacts + Curios**.
- **Iron's Spells X Epic Fight** — connects spellcasting and action combat.
- **Punchy!**, **Punchy! Moves** and **Combat Punchy** — first-person and movement animations with automatic Epic Fight handoffs.
- **Punchy! x Iron's Spells First-Person Animation Fix** — a dedicated compatibility addon.

**Removed:** Samurai Dynasty, Immersive Armors, ParCool and its Epic Fight compatibility addons.

**Continuing:** Epic Fight, Weapons of Miracles, Simply Swords, Knight Quest and Knaves' Needs. The beta supplies additional item artwork through its pack resources.

## World generation, biomes and wildlife

**Added**

- **Wildshape** — the new terrain direction for TK3.
- **Streams Reflowing** and **Flow Control** — flowing rivers and tools for working with them.
- **Nature's Spirit** and **Autumnity** — additional environments, trees and building materials.
- **Let's Do WilderNature**, **Hybrid Aquatic** and **Modern Apple Cows** — expand the wildlife selection.
- **Leaves Be Gone** — faster cleanup of unsupported leaves after tree harvesting.

**Replaced**

| TK2 | TK3 |
|---|---|
| Tectonic terrain setup | Wildshape terrain setup |
| Alex's Mobs | Alex's Mobs NeoForge port |
| Alex's Caves | Alex's Caves NeoForge port |
| Fast Leaf Decay | Leaves Be Gone |

**Removed:** Oh The Biomes We've Gone, Oh The Trees You'll Grow, Project Vibrant Journeys, Ecospherical Expansion, Dense Ores Abundant, Enhanced Celestials and Nyf's Spiders.

**Continuing:** Biomes O' Plenty, Regions Unexplored and Upgrade Aquatic. Alex's Mobs and Alex's Caves also continue through their replacement ports.

## Dimensions

**Added:** **Deep Aether**, **Aether Villages**, **Amplified Nether** and **Jaden's Nether Expansion**.

**Replaced**

| TK2 | TK3 |
|---|---|
| BetterEnd | BetterEnd: New Dawn |
| BetterNether | BetterNether: New Dawn |

**Removed:** **Ad Astra** and its space progression, **Aether Redux**, **Aether Lost Content** and **Twilight Tweaks**.

**Continuing:** The Aether, Twilight Forest and Deeper and Darker, alongside the expanded Nether and End. Deep Aether expands an existing destination; the Aether itself is carried over from TK2.

**Access changed:** Dimension Access Manager and TK2's blanket factory-stage dimension locks are removed. Exploration dimensions and the Wither remain outside mandatory factory progression. End Remastered and Twilight Forest retain their own access and progression rules.

## Bosses, dungeons and structures

**Added**

- **Archaion: Echoes of the Fallen** — the Ancient Keep, its trials and the Last of Deepslate boss.
- **Legendary Monsters** and **Bosses'Rise** — additional encounters.
- **Ancient Remnants: Monoliths** — discoverable monuments and ancient powers.
- **Integrated Cataclysm**, **Integrated Mowzie's Mobs** and **Integrated Seven Seas** — more integrated encounter and structure content.
- **YUNG's Better Mineshafts** — a new addition to the structure selection.
- **Epic Structures: Dungeons**, **Epic Structures: Jungle Temples** and **Epic Structures: Witch Huts** — reworked landmarks and dungeon exploration.
- **Universal Boss Respawner** — rematch cages for supported bosses.

**Replaced**

| TK2 | TK3 |
|---|---|
| When Dungeons Arise | Integrated Dungeons Arise, with reworked structures and mod integration |
| YUNG's Better Dungeons | Epic Structures: Dungeons |
| YUNG's Better Jungle Temples | Epic Structures: Jungle Temples |
| YUNG's Better Witch Huts | Epic Structures: Witch Huts |
| Remaining selected YUNG's structures | Their NeoForge counterparts |

**Removed:** **Ice and Fire**, **Dragonseeker**, **The Graveyard**, **Structory**, **Medieval Buildings**, **Sky Villages**, **Explorations**, **YUNG's Bridges** and **Alex's Caves: Stuff & Torpedoes**.

**Continuing:** Cataclysm, Mowzie's Mobs, Integrated Dungeons and Structures, Integrated Stronghold and Integrated Villages. YUNG's Desert Temples, Nether Fortresses, Ocean Monuments and End Island continue through their ports.

Cataclysm and Mowzie's Mobs were already in TK2; their **Integrated** addons are the additions here.

## Magic and spellcasting

**Added**

- **Just Another Witchery Remake** — a separate witchcraft path.
- **Ars Elemental**, **Ars Creo** and **Create: Wizardry** — expand Ars Nouveau and its connections with machinery.
- **Resonant Arcana**, **Cataclysm: Spellbooks** and **Legendary Spellbooks** — expand the spell selection.
- **Reliquified Iron's Spells** and **Apotheosis x Iron's Spellbooks Compat** — connect spellcasting to accessories and equipment.

**Replaced**

| TK2 | TK3 |
|---|---|
| Mana Unification | Ars 'n Spells for the Ars Nouveau / Iron's Spells connection |

**Removed:** Botania, MythicBotany, Malum, Reliquary Reincarnations and T.O Tweaks.

**Continuing:** Ars Nouveau and Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks. Both already existed in TK2 and receive a larger integration role in TK3.

## Enchanting and equipment upgrades

**Added:** **Tons Of Enchants**, **Apothic Enchanting**, **Apothic Spawners** and **Apothic Compats**.

Apothic Enchanting and Apothic Spawners are part of Apotheosis's newer modular setup. Their appearance as separate mods does not mean enchanting and spawner upgrades are entirely new to the pack.

**Removed:** Ensorcellation and Neko's Enchanted Books.

**Continuing:** Apotheosis, Apothic Attributes and Create: Enchantment Industry. Apotheosis station recipes now fit into the pack's manufacturing tiers.

## Create, industry and power

**Added**

- **Immersive Engineering** — heavy industry, electrical wiring, the Crusher, Arc Furnace and Excavator.
- **Create Nuclear** — nuclear engineering within the Create selection.
- **Create: Applied Kinetics** — more connections between Create and AE2.
- **Create: Rubberworks** — the sap and rubber route used by early manufacturing.
- **Create: Aquatic Ambitions**, **Create: Dragons Plus** and **Create Slice & Dice**.
- **Alchemical Lasers** — lens-based processing used throughout the new production route.

**Replaced**

| TK2 | TK3 |
|---|---|
| Thermal / The Factory Must Grow industrial tiers | Immersive Engineering integrated with Create |
| Dreams & Desires rubber route | Create: Rubberworks |
| CobbleGenRandomizer | The pack's Create-based stone generators |

**Removed**

- **Thermal Foundation**, **Thermal Expansion**, **Thermal Dynamics**, **Thermal Innovation** and **Thermal Cultivation**.
- **Create: The Factory Must Grow**, **Create: Dreams & Desires** and **Create: Stuff & Additions**.
- **Create: Oppenheimered**, **Create: Confectionery**, **Create: Bitterballen** and **Petrol's Parts**.

**Continuing:** Create, Create: Crafts & Additions, Create Diesel Generators, Create: Enchantment Industry, Create: Central Kitchen and Create Deco. Diesel Generators was already present in TK2 and remains the selected fuel-production mod.

## Storage, transport and travel

**Added**

- **ExtendedAE** — expands the existing AE2 network and storage options.
- **Pretty Pipes** — pipe-based item routing alongside the Create and AE2 logistics options.
- **Create Aeronautics** and **Create: Hypertubes** — new transport projects.
- **Create Aeronautics: FTB Chunks** — claim integration for Aeronautics.
- **Angel Ring** — a crafted flight option later in progression.
- **Sophisticated Backpacks Create Integration**, **Sophisticated Storage Create Integration** and **Yukami's Sophisticated Backpack Tab**.
- **Waystones / FTB Chunks Compatibility** and **Waystones: Sable** — support the current travel and moving-build setup.

**Replaced**

| TK2 | TK3 |
|---|---|
| Ender Storage | Linked Chests, including linked chests and pouches |
| Corpse | Death Keeper's gravestones |

**Removed:** Create: Steam 'n' Rails, JourneyMap, JourneyMap Integration, Paragliders, Elytra Slot, Beyond Mines: Falling, Carry On, Corpse, Trash Cans and Inventory Sorter.

**Continuing:** Applied Energistics 2, Sophisticated Storage, Sophisticated Backpacks, Waystones and FTB Chunks. Create trains remain part of Create; the Steam 'n' Rails addon is the removal.

## Questing, trading and multiplayer

**Added**

- **TnK Workshop** — the Quest Projector, construction tools, cages, mirrors and Trading Hub.
- **Create: Trading Floor** and **wd's Selling Bin** — new trading and selling options.
- **Certain Questing Additions**, **ExtraQuests** and **Quests Kill Task Tweaks** — support the rebuilt questbook.

**Removed:** Create: Numismatics, Create: Missions, QuestsAdditions, Starter Kit and Simple Voice Chat.

**Continuing:** FTB Quests, FTB Teams, FTB Ranks, FTB Essentials, FTB Chunks, Lootr and PVP Flagging.

**Also replaced:** Simple Discord RPC's presence role moves into TnK Workshop.

The questbook is being rebuilt around **Town Square**, **Forging Ahead**, **Crafts & Curiosities**, **Realms & Relics** and **Seasonal Tales**. Ten production chapters sit alongside Tutorial, Progression, Market, Useful Items, Bulletin Board, Exploration, Bosses, The Eyes and mod-specific branches. The target is at least **1,500 useful quests**; the beta's book remains in progress.

The **Trading Hub** is a directory for player shops and other destinations, with search, icons and Waystones travel. Players conduct trades at the destinations they visit.

## Building, decoration and settlements

**Added**

- **Arts & Crafts**, **Block Pack**, **Biomes O' Plenty: Chipped** and **Rechiseled: Chipped**.
- **Let's Do Furniture**, **Let's Do Lili's Pottery**, **Let's Do Hearth & Timber**, **Let's Do Camping** and **Let's Do Alpine Whispers**.
- **Construction Sticks** — construction tools taking over the previous Construction Wand role.
- **TnK Workshop's** Measuring Pencil, Builder's Satchel, Builder's Brush and Quest Projector add practical tools for player-built towns.

**Removed**

- **MineColonies**, **TownTalk**, **StyleColonies**, the **Byzantine style pack**, **Domum Ornamentum**, **Structurize** and **Multi-Piston** — the previous colony-management selection.
- **Another Furniture**, **Beautify**, **Dawn of Time**, **Handcrafted** and **Refurbished Furniture**.
- **Create: Bells & Whistles** and **Create: Interiors**.
- **Construction Wand**, **Visual Workbench** and **Immersive Melodies**.

**Continuing:** Chipped, Rechiseled, Architect's Palette, Supplementaries, Amendments, Quark, Create Deco, Create: Copycats+, Diagonal Fences, Torchmaster and Etched. Town building now centres on player-built settlements, shared infrastructure and shops.

## Farming, food and fishing

**Added**

- **Croptopia** and **Farmer's Delight Croptopia**.
- **Corn Delight**, **Veggies Delight**, **Fruits Delight**, **Nature's Delight** and **Hybrid Delights**.
- **Let's Do Farm & Charm** and **Let's Do Smoker**.
- **Starcatcher**, **Hybrid Aquatic** and their compatibility addon — the new fishing and aquatic selection.
- **Spice of Life: Carrot Edition** — food-variety progression.

**Replaced**

| TK2 | TK3 |
|---|---|
| Legacy Let's Do Bakery | Let's Do Bakery's Farm & Charm version |
| Legacy Let's Do Brewery | Let's Do Brewery's Farm & Charm version |
| Aquaculture 2 fishing selection | Starcatcher + Hybrid Aquatic |

**Removed:** Ender Crop, Harvest With Ease, Let's Do Meadow, Let's Do Candlelight and Let's Do NetherVinery.

**Continuing:** Farmer's Delight, Create: Central Kitchen, Let's Do Vinery, Let's Do HerbalBrews, Let's Do BloomingNature and Let's Do Beachparty.

## Interface, visuals and recipe discovery

**Added:** **BetterF3**, **Better Advanced Tooltips**, **Fancy Tab Sections**, **Obscure Tooltips**, **Simply Tooltips**, **Particular Reforged**, **Subtle Effects**, **Vanilla Backport**, **Polytone** and **GuideME**.

**Camera and atmosphere additions:** Shoulder Surfing Reloaded, Do a Barrel Roll, Reach Behind, Biome Music and Windy: Configurable.

**Jade integrations added:** Jade / Farmer's Delight Compatibility, Jade Sable Compat and Sophisticated Backpacks / Jade Compatibility.

**Replaced:** Blur → Blur+; Traveler's Titles → its NeoForge port.

**Removed:** Better Advancements, Client Tweaks, Durability Tooltip, Legendary Tooltips, More Overlays Updated, Falling Leaves, Visuality Reforged, Enhanced Block Entities, Continuity, Forge CIT, Entity Model Features, Entity Texture Features, Immersive UI, Catalogue, Server Tab Info and Remove Chat Bracket.

**Recipe browsing changes:** JEI stays, with named search groups, clearer item information and **97 custom Ponder lessons**. Just Enough Resources, Nature's Compass, Polymorph and Polymorphic Energistics are removed.

**Continuing:** Jade, Jade Addons, Colorful Hearts, Overloaded Armor Bar, Raw's Visual Keybinder, Medieval Music and Ponder for KubeJS. The beta also bundles its own interface, item and quest artwork through the pack resources.

## Performance and compatibility

**Replaced**

| TK2 | TK3 |
|---|---|
| Embeddium | Sodium |
| Oculus | Iris |
| Noisium | Noisiumed |

**Added:** AllTheLeaks, Concurrent Chunk Management Engine, Create: Catalyst, Entity Culling, ImmediatelyFast, Lithium, MoreCulling, ScalableLux, GPUBooster Reforged, Ixeris, YAMO and No Structure Overlap.

**Removed:** Adaptive Performance Tweaks, AI Improvements, Achievements Optimizer, Embeddium++, CullLessLeaves Reforged, Farsight, FastWorkbench, Get It Together Drops, Let Me Despawn, Mobtimizations, No See No Tick, Saturn, Smooth Chunk Save, Structure Essentials, FTB Quests Optimizer, Does It Tick, DEUF, Detected setBlock Be Gone and SerializationIsBad.

**Continuing:** ModernFix, FerriteCore, Dynamic FPS, Connectivity, Observable and spark.

The change to NeoForge also replaces several supporting libraries. Forgified Fabric API remains in Beta 1.0; Sinytra Connector is removed. [The complete project comparison](../mods/comparison/) includes the dependency and support-tool changes.

## The main gameplay reworks

The mod changes support a new factory-to-adventure loop:

| Area | What changes in TK3 |
|---|---|
| Main progression | Ten chapters: Manual → Andesite → Copper → Brass → Calculation → Reinforced → Industrial → Arcane → Eclipse → Creation |
| Early factory | Manual mechanisms lead into cheaper Deployer production; Rubberworks supplies sap and rubber, including the more efficient Belt recipe |
| AE2 | Processors move from Inscribers to Create assembly, with reusable tooling; Calculation machinery leads into the ME Controller |
| Heavy industry | Create handles routine manufacturing while IE supplies heavy processing, electrical infrastructure and excavation |
| Ore processing | Supported ores progress through 1×, 2×, 4× and 5× processing |
| Renewable materials | Create stone generators, laser-grown Certus and tiered ExtendedAE Infinity Stone Cells support larger factories |
| Magic production | Ars materials, Mana, Dragon's Breath, spell-scroll production and Alchemical Lasers connect magic to manufacturing |
| Character builds | Twenty origins, activity progression, titles and a skill tree with a limited spending budget |
| Equipment rewards | Identify, compare and salvage equipment through Unidentified Loot; automate identification with Create |
| Exploration | Dimension access is independent of global factory stages, while discoveries feed useful materials back into the workshop |
| Settlements | Player-built towns, practical construction tools, quest displays and a Trading Hub connect community projects |

Detailed recipes and controls belong in the [progression guide](../progression/), [character guide](../character/) and [Workshop guide](../workshop/).

## Complete mod comparison

[Browse every added, retained and absent project](../mods/comparison/), including supporting libraries. [Snapshot sources](../status/) record the exact pack references behind this comparison.

Replacement ports keep their gameplay families in the pack: Alex's Caves, Alex's Mobs, BetterEnd, BetterNether, Loot Journal, Traveler's Titles and the continuing YUNG's structures remain through their newer projects.

title: Transport & Aeronautics
summary: Move yourself, supplies and ambitious builds around the world.
text:
# Transport & Aeronautics

Travel is another reason to develop your factory. Connect local production with Create logistics, then choose the transport that suits the distance and the kind of build.

## Create Aeronautics

Aeronautics and its selected compatibility stack support flying engineering projects. Build against the installed version's native mechanics and lessons; the pack's custom recipes establish construction costs rather than replacing its physics.

The custom Gyroscopic Mechanism route starts with a **Reinforced Mechanism**, then applies **Cogwheel, Shaft and Brass Nugget**, followed by a Press. It takes one pass and guarantees one output. Downstream recipes keep their own Gyro requirements.

The manifest includes the Aeronautics/FTB Chunks compatibility project and Waystones: Sable. Moving structures still have system-specific limitations. A Workshop Trading Hub is excluded from supported moving-base placement.

## Local movement

Create Hypertubes, belts, mechanical handling and native rail equipment offer different ways to organize a larger base. A cargo route should have a loading buffer, a predictable destination and somewhere for excess output to wait.

Sophisticated storage integrations and Applied Kinetics connect selected inventories and engineering. Their presence does not make every stationary modded block safe to use on every moving contraption.

## Teleport networks

Found Waystones remain part of exploration. Constructed Waystones use the Brass manufacturing direction with their native Warp Stone, three Obsidian and the defined stone silhouette.

Ordinary Waystone travel follows its server cost/cooldown rules. The Workshop **Trading Hub** has its own directory flow and configured free teleport behavior; it should not be confused with the cost of every Waystone teleport.

[Trading Hub guide](../trading-hub/) · [Current construction recipes](../recipes/) · [Ponder index](../ponder/)

title: Nuclear engineering
summary: Create Nuclear, Alex’s Caves and their distinct processing roles.
text:
# Nuclear engineering

Create Nuclear and Alex's Caves contribute different machinery and nuclear mechanics. Their recipes can connect without making their radiation systems identical.

## Create Nuclear

The current integration retains native Yellowcake enrichment and **five enriched Yellowcake per Fuel Rod**. Its controller and alarm construction use supported AE2, IE and Alex's Caves components rather than oversized piles of reactor casings.

The approved Reactor Core remains **Eclipse-gated by ingredients**. This is a construction requirement, not a global lock on visiting Toxic Caves.

Alex's raw Uranium and ore join the common uranium family. The basic crushed-Uranium route produces one tagged Dust; Industrial IE crushing supplies the established two-Dust upgrade.

Use the installed mod's native reactor and turbine guides. This wiki does not import an older Mekanism fission/fusion campaign into the current pack.

## Alex's Caves Nuclear Furnace

The construction route combines its required native components and the pack's factory ingredients. Six dedicated processing definitions add Coal Coke, Charred Remnants, Quartz/brick recovery and Blackstone work.

Those dedicated definitions require **nuclear_furnace_custom_type=true** in the Alex's Caves configuration. Both sides need the matching setup and restart; the script alone is not a config update.

Normal cooking is preserved through compatibility mirrors when the dedicated type is enabled. JEI and the installed configuration determine the active result.

## Protective equipment

Optional hazmat upcycling creates **Create Nuclear's native suit and radiation protection**. It does not merge Alex's and Create Nuclear's effects or make either suit automatically protect against both systems.

## What stays disabled

The craftable Alex's Caves Nuclear Bomb and primed bomb entity are blocked by the selected pack rules. Toxic Caves, the Nuclear Furnace, reactor behavior and other nuclear effects remain separate.
